meta_description:
7,432 likes, 100 comments - casarthakahuja on May 21, 2026: "This week, I visited Chikkmagaluru, the Coffee Capital of India...

Staying at a local plantation with Bharat, the founder of Bili Hu Coffee... we unpacked everything around the rising coffee culture in India...

How is Indian coffee different from that in other parts of the world?

Where are people innovating in coffee and making money off of the rising interest in specialty coffees?

How he started this business with less than Rs 10 lakhs in capital, and there’s still so much space for more players to enter.

Check out this episode of Founder’s Office with Sarthak Ahuja...

Directed and Produced by Aditi Randev.

https://youtu.be/adjh9ZFoq3o".
